notes.title: Little Laps is OUT NOW!
notes.notes: [p]Hi everyone![/p][p]I'm happy to announce that Little Laps is [b]OUT NOW[/b]!!![/p][p][dynamiclink href="https://store.steampowered.com/app/2642370/Little_Laps/"][/dynamiclink]The game is on a [b]20% launch discount[/b] for the first week, so make sure to get it before then if you're interested![/p][p]As well, if you own any of our previous games, you can get the game for an even further discount through the [b]bundles[/b] that you can find on the store page![/p][p]If you're played the demo previously, the final game is [b]majorly expanded[/b]. Namely:[/p][list][*][p]3 → 18 tracks[/p][/*][*][p]18 → 69 achievements[/p][/*][*][p]5 → 15 vehicles[/p][/*][*][p]3 → 18 online leaderboards[/p][/*][/list][p]Also, we just posted a [b]YouTube devlog[/b] covering the [b]full development[/b] of the game, so give that a watch if you want to see what went into creating it![/p][previewyoutube="FXVbmCLXdws;full"][/previewyoutube][p]Thanks again to everyone for supporting the game so far! If you enjoy it, [b]leaving a review would be immensely helpful[/b]. It's the second best thing you could do after getting the game![/p][p]I'll see you all for the next update![/p][p]- Conrad, Lead Developer[/p]

notes.title: Little Laps Launches August 5th!
notes.notes: [p]Hi everyone![/p][p]I'm happy to announce that Little Laps will release on August 5th! It will be available in [b]11 languages[/b], cost [b]$5.99 USD[/b] (or equivalent), and launch with a [b]10% launch discount[/b]![/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45648947/651c24751c4de02293586d87748c93692b46b042.gif"][/img][/p][p]Furthermore, we're also be bundling with one of my main inspirations for this game, [b]The Ramp[/b]! [/p][p][dynamiclink href="https://store.steampowered.com/app/1506510/The_Ramp/"][/dynamiclink][/p][p]The free demo is also currently live on the Steam page, so try it out if you want to see what the final game will be like![/p][p][dynamiclink href="https://store.steampowered.com/app/2642370/Little_Laps"][/dynamiclink]That's it for this update, and make sure to wishlist Little Laps to be notified when it comes out![/p][p]See you all soon![/p][p]- Conrad, Lead Developer[/p]

notes.title: On Little Laps' Demo
notes.notes: [p]Hi everyone![/p][p]It's been a few days since Little Laps was announced and its demo launched, and I just wanted to thank you all for the warm reception![/p][p]The game's online leaderboards are populating super well, and while people are starting to get close to my best times, [b]I still hold the world records on all 3 demo courses[/b]! Some people are getting suuuper close though, especially 50-50 Cent in Greens![/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45648947/3d34b9144cddd93977a1a7ea57a3f40f0f00058c.png"][/img][/p][p]The main reason I'm making this post is to let you all know that if you want to support the game, [b]wishlisting the Steam page[/b], and especially [b]reviewing the demo[/b] are amazing ways to do that! [/p][p][dynamiclink href="https://store.steampowered.com/app/3778590/Little_Laps_Demo/"][/dynamiclink][/p][p]If you want to help out, you can do that, and otherwise I'll see you in the next update! Thanks again for playing![/p][p]- Conrad, Lead Developer[/p]

notes.title: Next Fest STARTS NOW!
notes.notes:
[p]Hi everyone![/p][p]I'm happy to announce that Little Laps' demo is participating in Steam's Next Fest RIGHT NOW![/p][p][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45648947/f8fc19f5f48b597ae64e4ee49800b2856f9d1834.gif"][/img][/p][p][/p][p][dynamiclink href="https://store.steampowered.com/app/3778590/Little_Laps_Demo/"][/dynamiclink][/p][p]The demo features:[/p][p]🏁 3 tracks[/p][p]✅ 18 achievements[/p][p]🏎️ 5 unlockable cars[/p][p]📊 Online leaderboards[/p][p]👻 Ghost replays to race against[/p][p]
If you want to support the game, make sure to [b]wishlist[/b] it, play the demo, and [b]leave a review[/b] if you enjoyed it![/p][p]Please let me know if you have any feedback for the demo, and I'll see you all in the next post![/p][p]- Conrad, Lead Developer[/p]

notes.title: Welcome to Little Laps!
notes.notes: [p]Hi everyone![/p][p]This is Conrad, Lead Developer of Conradical Games and Little Laps! We just announced the game today, and I wanted to share the video I recently uploaded that covers some of the behind the scenes of development![/p][p][/p][previewyoutube="l2xfVTpp3fw;full"][/previewyoutube][p]The game also released with a demo, so check that out if you want to see what the core experience is like! The demo has:[/p][p]🏁 3 tracks[/p][p]✅ 18 achievements[/p][p]🏎️ 5 unlockable cars[/p][p]📊 Online leaderboards[/p][p]👻 Ghost replays to race against[/p][p][/p][p][dynamiclink href="https://store.steampowered.com/app/3778590/Little_Laps_Demo/"][/dynamiclink][/p][p]That's it for this update, and make sure to wishlist the game if you want to be notified of any other updates, or when the game releases (which will have a launch discount)![/p][p]- Conrad, Lead Developer[/p]
